title: Rikoll's Primary
wikitext:
[[Rikoll]]'s draft team for the [[Salvation Season 2]]. The other players were picked in the following order: [[Moltas]], [[Skillah]], [[pericles]] and [[Xenic]].

There was also a div 2 team formed consisting of the following players: [[anupko]], [[marvel]], [[lacuna]], [[mushi]], [[norules]] and [[Jissse]].
